market: Deribit BTC options; not US-listed utility evidence
selection: First-day largest summed eligible base-coin amount; lexicographic tie break; expiry strictly after panel end; creation no later than panel start

forecast.reference: Last eligible trade with event timestamp <= cutoff and age <=30min at cutoff
forecast.target: Last eligible trade in (decision, decision+30min]; decision=cutoff+60sec; target interval entirely inside panel
forecast.estimand: Log target trade price minus log last available reference trade price, conditional on eligible future trade arrival; absence is missing, never zero
forecast.availability: Historical event-time + assumed60sec lag; no receipt-time claim

completion_policy: Any budget exhaustion, unresolved discovery tie, inconsistent sequence, metadata mismatch or acquisition error makes panel incomplete and ineligible for fitting
execution: Explicit CLI --collect required; no authentication, purchase or order APIs
utility_scope: Separate flow-information/no-flow-ablation assessment from sampler accuracy, reliability and workflow cost. Weak or zero flow findings can be useful; no alpha/profit requirement.
grid_policy: Preserve scheduled grid, missing masks and all-origin denominator. No zero-fill, imputation or compressed irregular rows. Existing balanced-panel ingest cannot fit missing outcomes; require explicit validated masked likelihood/new adapter before fitting.
phase_purge: Exclude training/validation outcomes whose assumed availability extends past phase boundary or held-out origin.
pagination: Expand first/last timestamp probes to complete tie pages; freeze min/max sequence; sequence-only pages validate duplicates and range then sort locally; require overlap and contiguous final sequence set. Saturated timestamp ties fail incomplete.
supersedes_attempt: deribit-access-panel-v2: history response contained unique complete but unsorted sequence page
historical_host_evidence: deribit-history-host-probe-v1: same fixed historical day returned trades with include_old=true
